The '''Alliance Elite Guard''' was an elite [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel trooper]] unit in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that was tasked with defending high ranking officials, such as [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It is possible they were reformed as part of the [[New Republic Honor Guard]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==History==
===Galactic Civil War===
Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was without a clear command chain. To clear up the confusion, important Rebel battles often required a [[Field Commander/Legends|Field Commander]]. They would provide the link between ground forces and high ranking [[General/Legends|generals]].

Since the Alliance was a guerrilla force, without clearly defined territory, field commanders would most often be leading an attack, as opposed to defending from inside a base. Field commanders were, therefore, major targets.

In order to protect valuable [[Officer/Legends|officers]], commanders were accompanied by a squad of four Alliance Elite Guards. These guards would stay with them at all times, protecting from enemy counterattacks.

===Legacy===
After the deaths of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] over [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]], it is possible that they were reformed and merged with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Honor Guard|Honor Guard]].

==Training==
These forces were given the same training as standard Alliance soldiers. They had a higher emphasis on defensive fighting and maintaining a tight squad. Certain members were also trained for specific environments, in case fighting took place on special types of planets. They were given the same equipment as normal soldiers.

==Behind the scenes==
The Alliance Elite Guard appears in ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'' as the counterpart to the [[Imperial Elite Guard]]. Essentially the same as ordinary Rebel troops, they possess higher hit points and attack.
